head.text: Both pages run in the same viewer and read pure data files. The skills page is built from the frontmatter of every published SKILL.md; the marks page reads nine SVG files and their construction overlays. Both crops follow the deck theme.

figures.caption: 261 skills in three groups: 209 engineering and 39 productivity skills from the wiki and 13 from the General Translation repository, each row a number, a name and a description.
Nine marks in three families, bilingual, counterform and reflection, in the judged order, at 96 pixels positive and reversed. Each is one filled path on a 256 unit grid.
